concepts.def: Mean = sum/n. Median = middle value of ordered data. Mode = most frequent value. Different averages, different uses.
Range = max − min. IQR = Q₃ − Q₁ (middle 50% spread). Standard deviation σ = √(variance), more sensitive measure.
Values far from the rest. Common rule: outside Q₁ − 1.5·IQR or Q₃ + 1.5·IQR. May skew mean.
Random, stratified, systematic, opportunity, quota. Aim: representative of population without bias.
Show min, Q₁, median, Q₃, max. Visualise spread, skew, outliers. Useful for comparing distributions.
Running total. Plotting against upper class boundary gives an S-curve, used to estimate medians and quartiles.
